name_input: M/S REGENT HITECH P.LTD; REGENT HITECH PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs records page for REGENT HITECH PRIVATE LIMITED (address 4B/1- GANGARAM HOSPITAL MARG) shows "Total Shipments 23 Records detected", "Trading Partners 3", "Latest Cargo 2026-01-25". Exact rows seen (5 of 23 displayed): (1) 2026-01-25, buyer UNION PAPER MILLS, "REGENT KNIFE GATE VALVE 5 (SHW-125) S-SERIES, MOC: SS 304, TABLE-PN10, HW-", origin port DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India -> DUBAI, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES, HS 84818030, BOL 9063299; (2) 2025-12-17, buyer EAST AFRICAN PAPER MILLS LIMITED, "REGENT KNIFE GATE VALVE 3 (SHW-80 MM) RS SERIES FULL SS BODY 304 TAVLE -E HW-", TUGLAKABAD ICD -> Mombasa, Kenya, HS 84818030, BOL 7968225; (3) 2025-12-10, buyer EAST AFRICAN PAPER MILLS LIMITED, "REGENT KNIFE GATE VALVE 14 (SHW-350 MM)RS-SERIES, FULL SS BODY-304, TABLE-E, HW-", DELHI AIR CARGO ACC -> NAIROBI, Kenya, HS 84818030, BOL 7741709; (4) 2025-02-27, buyer DURGA PULPS PVT LTD., "REGENT KNIFE GATE VALVE 16 (KPO-400)", Raxaul INRXLB -> Birgunj, NEPAL, HS 84818030, BOL 8560195; (5) 2024-12-18, buyer TERHATHUM POWER COMPANY LIMITED, "REGENT SPARES OF KNIFE GATE VALVE SIZE24 (MHW-600) MULTI -TURN (BEVEL) GEARBOX, MODEL:VGB 600", Raxaul -> Birgunj, NEPAL, HS 84818030, BOL 6545879. Source counter: page states 23 total shipments; 5 individual rows actually rendered/seen. Ports listed: DELHI AIR CARGO ACC 6, TUGLAKABAD ICD 6, Mombasa 6, NAIROBI 6, DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4 1.
note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with destination and HS code: real outbound shipments to UAE (Dubai), Kenya (Mombasa, Nairobi) and Nepal (Birgunj) between 2024-12-18 and 2026-01-25, all under HS 84818030 (knife gate valves and spares) — consistent with the declared HS 848180 (industrial valves), so no HS correction needed. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could not be retrieved: DuckDuckGo search backend returned connection refused on both attempts, and volza.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403. Therefore domestic_status is recorded as unknown, not as none_found — absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not a finding. Revenue and export volume figures are not public in the accessible sources: null, not estimated. Note the ImportKey page labels the company as 'Supplier' in its buyer/supplier tables, i.e. the records are export-side (Indian supplier -> foreign buyer), which matches the shipment descriptions. No registry or catalogue data used.
